objective: Run the frozen exploratory census on uniform growth U(n), n = 100, 200, 400, and the tree control: forced fraction, reach and shell profile from co-knotted pairs and knots, beyond ties, split into propagation and search, at half, three quarters and the last base.
status: Supported 2026-11-12 (frozen, exploratory, referee pending): B1 to B3 held at 100 and 200 distinctions (local before the end; a pair decides 85% and 82% at the last base); B4 failed at 200 (6.1% beyond ties against 5%; by propagation 0.2%); 400 undecided (all 20 runs over the 30-minute cap, after the registered run was stopped with nothing written).
title: Global influence on random finite samples
